# AR BI Consulting

> AR BI Consulting is an independent Business Intelligence consultancy based in Islamabad, Pakistan. It builds Power BI dashboards, DAX and SQL solutions, Excel dashboards, data models and automated reports. Tagline: Turn Data Into Decisions. Experience: 4.7+ years.

## Key facts
- Business type: independent Business Intelligence and data analytics consulting (not a large organization)
- Location: Islamabad, Pakistan (works remotely with clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe and other markets)
- Contact email: arbiconsultings@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +92 310 2521471
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ali-raza-7b95171b9/
- Website: https://alicaptn.github.io/

## Services
- Power BI Dashboard Development: Interactive dashboards that bring sales, finance and operations into one place, built around the questions your team asks every week.
- Advanced DAX Development: Custom measures for the metrics standard visuals cannot produce: year-over-year change, running totals, ratios, rankings and time intelligence.
- SQL Development & Database Reporting: Clean, efficient queries, views and stored procedures that turn your databases into dependable reporting sources.
- Microsoft Excel Dashboard Development: Interactive Excel dashboards using formulas, pivots and slicers for teams who prefer to stay in the tool they know.
- Power Query & Data Transformation: Repeatable data preparation that cleans, merges and reshapes messy files and exports, so no one fixes the same spreadsheet by hand twice.
- Data Modeling & Semantic Models: Star-schema models and shared semantic layers, so every report uses the same definitions for revenue, customers and cost.
- Business Intelligence Consulting: Practical advice on reporting strategy, KPI selection and tooling, plus review of what you already have.
- Dashboard Optimization & Performance Tuning: We diagnose slow reports and speed them up by tuning model size, calculations, queries and visuals.
- Automated Business Reporting: Scheduled refreshes and report delivery, so weekly and monthly packs build themselves.
- KPI & Executive Reporting Solutions: Concise executive views that show what is on track and what needs attention, without a wall of charts.

## Working process
Discover, Analyze, Design, Develop, Deliver.

## Industries
Finance and banking, sales and marketing, education, healthcare, retail and e-commerce, operations and management.
